column1: # Hebrew business-name words (curated 2026-11-10). Israeli names are a family name or a brand word
# and the trade: כהן הנדסה, אורן השקעות. Many Israeli firms use English names (name_languages.tsv
# gives English half the share). Words carry the Latin form these firms use after "=", used for
# domains. A section key serves every division of the section that has no row of its own.
